paras: The ADRO V2 dual-element spoiler is designed to give the BMW G80 M3 & G20 M340i a more aggressive and refined rear profile.

V2 features a dual-element layout that adds depth and visual separation at the rear of the car. This layered design creates a stronger presence while maintaining clean lines that follow the factory trunk shape for an OEM-plus look.
